brief:
Gaza's health ministry said Israeli forces have killed 1,501 Palestinians since an October 2025 ceasefire took effect, Middle East Eye reported. The toll underscores the scale of violence that has persisted despite the agreement meant to end hostilities.

The ministry did not specify the circumstances of individual deaths or provide additional details about how the casualties occurred during the ceasefire period.
dek: Gaza health ministry says 1,501 Palestinians killed since October 2025 'ceasefire' Israeli forces have killed a total of 1,501 Palestinians since the October 2025 “ceasefire”, Gaza's health ministry says.
title: Gaza reports 1,501 Palestinians killed since October ceasefire began
